notes: Tester round 3 (thanks Mirko!): the mode display could stay stuck on the last mode it had mapped (e.g. cap/res) when the firmware's ':DMM:CONFigure?' reply named no function we recognise — instead of ignoring such a reply, one labeled ':READ?' probe now asks the meter directly what function it is measuring, and the display follows it within about a second. This also covers the AC/DC SELECT button: if the probe had been switched off earlier because it timed out, it gets a bounded second chance instead of staying off, and a run of OL replies can no longer keep the probe spinning. Oscilloscope + Multimeter windows: the 'BETA' chip next to CONNECT looked like a button — it is now a plain small text label (with a hover hint saying it means 'beta feature, still under development').
